# The Stack — Git-native AI Workforce Control Centre

The Stack is a zero-spend, git-native control centre for orchestrating AI agents, jobs, notes, and chats. Built on vanilla JS web components, PWA-enabled, and deployed to GitHub Pages.

## Key Pages
- https://lilfangsproject-wq.github.io/the-stack-ui/ — Main command centre
- https://lilfangsproject-wq.github.io/the-stack-ui/phone.html — Mobile companion
- https://lilfangsproject-wq.github.io/the-stack-ui/pair.html — Device pairing
- https://lilfangsproject-wq.github.io/the-stack-ui/cloud.html — Cloud sync view
